notes: Source decision fixed from completed seed02 RX1 matrix and independent full-log/default-head analysis. CLEAN_SIG qualification implies NONE+CLEAN_SIG formal paired controls, else independently confirmed NONE only; no target-dependent choice.

All new rows scratch20/full-five-RX/default head. Current source-fold weights are incompatible and never loaded. Original BASE_SSL E20 all3 seeds are a matched historical control with actualLS0/13L+7U/CENTER25K/fullFP32 and identical physical roles.

New default-head final prediction uses actual deployed joint160. Local all3seed/mode200state equality to original initializations, feature-only=joint160 and W-perturbation independence verified; no new fitted classifier.

No training RX mask/anchors/new loss/extra optimizer step/extra IQ forward/new parameters; original U gate,ownEMA,Gaussian U,NoExplicitCFO/internal compensation and cosine schedule retained. No L/satellite augmentation.

NONE removes t2 dropout; CLEAN_SIG preserves its original main mask/RNG but reads before it only for signature, retaining both gradients. Upstream stochasticity remains. Same-weight eval deployed features/head logits are equivalent.

First seed all registered arms train/freeze then source health vs own same-seed original BASE_SSL (trainingLCE<=.5,V drop<=.01,worstRX drop<=.02). Any failure closes before target; later seed health is report-only, no selective restart or seed exclusion.

After necessary first-seed gate, each frozen row automatically clean168000 prediction then fresh CPU truth-last score. GPU training parent never reads target scores; final aggregation also fresh CPU. Original correctness paired by exact physical IDs; if present CLEAN_SIG vs NONE paired separately.

Mean/sampleSD/positive seeds/MacroF1/worstRX/day and corrected/new errors reported for every registered arm; fixed primary never chosen from target. Benchmark already exposed, not independent blind test.

Default-head accuracy can include W changes; no unsupported claim of discarded-W/newTX/satellite transfer. Existing CENTER25K and other historical positives preserved; no resurrected failed window/decay/LOCKED scan.
p2_min_v1/VALIDATED_ONCE handles reused unchanged; scientific data/source legality and checkpoint provenance checked, no new data validation/hash/receipt chain.
REJECTED_EXTRA_GATE: separate design approval, report-only review, per-member hash, extra runner review or signature/authority machinery; current minimal workflow applies.
